reference_links.claim: Topic modeling is investigated as a way to organize library and information-science literature.
reference_links.scope: Related methods background; no nanomaterial equipment performance claim.

reference_links.claim: ZipTok3D studies compact learned representations of three-dimensional geometry.
reference_links.scope: Adjacent computational background; relevance to this ontology remains exploratory.

reference_links.claim: caNanoLab describes structured sharing of nanomaterial characterization and biomedical research data.
reference_links.scope: Database-design context; no validation of the equipment catalog.

reference_links.claim: This review discusses machine learning approaches to nanomaterial discovery and design.
reference_links.scope: Review background; not an implemented prediction capability in this app.

reference_links.claim: This review surveys applications and limitations of machine learning in nanomaterials research.
reference_links.scope: Literature context; not model-specific equipment evidence.

reference_links.claim: The paper analyzes standards for constructing a modular nanosafety metadata schema.
reference_links.scope: Schema-design context; the project has not claimed compliance with that schema.

reference_links.claim: eNanoMapper uses ontologies to integrate data for nanomaterial risk assessment.
reference_links.scope: Ontology background; no formal mapping to eNanoMapper has been asserted.

reference_links.claim: The paper evaluates a metadata system intended to describe diverse nanomaterials and nanostructures.
reference_links.scope: Conceptual metadata context; not proof of coverage or conformance by this catalog.

reference_links.claim: The paper presents ontology-based knowledge graphs for material-processing chains and contextual metadata.
reference_links.scope: Design context; this catalog is not claimed to implement the paper's ontology or graph system.

reference_links.claim: The paper discusses shared metadata and FAIR data practices for computational and experimental materials science.
reference_links.scope: Metadata-design background; no assertion that all recommendations are implemented.

reference_links.claim: The review organizes literature on nanocomposite microstructure and electrical and mechanical properties.
reference_links.scope: Review background; nanocomposite findings are not assigned to specific instruments.

reference_links.claim: The supplied manuscript studies optical measurements of magnetization switching in individual magnetite nanoparticles.
reference_links.scope: Specific experiment in the paper; no commercial catalog model or synthesis route is validated.

reference_links.claim: The paper develops a language-model framework for magnesium-alloy design using processing information.
reference_links.scope: Adjacent materials-informatics background; not an implemented tool feature.

reference_links.claim: nanoPharos presents a case study of FAIR nanomaterial data and metadata management.
reference_links.scope: Database-design context; no interoperability or compliance claim is made.

reference_links.claim: The paper examines ways to evaluate completeness and quality of curated nanomaterial data.
reference_links.scope: Curation-policy background; the proposed checks have not been fully applied to every catalog assertion.

reference_links.claim: The paper describes a CODATA effort toward multidisciplinary nanotechnology metadata standards.
reference_links.scope: Standards-development context; not a conformance certification for this project.

reference_links.claim: NEMAD presents an experiment-based magnetic-materials database assembled with language-model assistance.
reference_links.scope: Database-design context; its entries are not imported into this equipment catalog.

reference_links.claim: Magnetite nanoparticles provide an example of magnetic behavior within the metal-oxide nanoparticle family.
reference_links.scope: Material-family context only. This does not support the N02 synthesis sequence, an instrument model, or ownership/access.
